fragmentation.title: Security operations were never designed to run across disconnected tools.
fragmentation.description: Reports, planning, messaging, customer requirements and operational records are often spread across separate systems. Every handover introduces friction, duplication and lost context.

pillars.title: One platform. Six operational pillars.
pillars.description: Every pillar shares the same organizational, object, user and audit context — one connected operational system, not a collection of unrelated modules.

capabilities.description: Every capability shares the same operational context, security model and organizational structure. Different workflows. One platform foundation.

ai.title: AI that supports the report. Not the decision.
ai.description: AI capabilities are built on top of structured operational data, secure workflows and validated platform context. ISB AI assists with structure, clarity and completeness while keeping the officer and supervisor responsible for the final operational record.

trust.title: Trust starts with architecture.

industries.title: Built around the way security operations actually differ.
industries.description: Object security, mobile patrol, events, healthcare and government operations do not share the same risk profile or workflow. ISB is designed to adapt without fragmenting the underlying platform.

frag.aria: Architecture diagram: fragmented operational sources, friction layer, and ISB unified platform
frag.summary: Operational information in security organizations is commonly distributed across paper reports, spreadsheets, messaging, email, customer portals, shared folders and manual handovers. These handoffs create operational friction including duplicate entry, missing context, delayed escalation, version conflicts and weak traceability. ISB Security Platform provides a unified operational layer for reporting, objects, people, patrols, compliance and intelligence, producing controlled outputs such as management oversight, supervisor review, client visibility and compliance evidence.

operations.title: Operations
operations.summary: Coordinate shifts, patrols, tasks and escalations within a shared operational context — not as isolated messages or spreadsheets.
operations.outcome: Shared operational context for shifts, patrols and escalations. Duty journal and handovers are planned.

reporting.title: Reporting
reporting.summary: Structured operational documentation — from field observation to approved record — with human review remaining mandatory.
reporting.outcome: Traceable operational records suitable for internal oversight and client evidence.

people.title: People
people.summary: Personnel, roles, qualifications and assignments bound to the same objects and operational rules as the rest of the platform.
people.outcome: Qualified personnel in the right place, with activity retained for review.

objects.title: Objects
objects.summary: The physical hierarchy that anchors every report, patrol and instruction — from customer to checkpoint and asset.
objects.outcome: One shared site model for every operational action and requirement.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.summary: Governance and traceability designed into the platform — access boundaries, evidence and change history.
compliance.outcome: Defensible operational evidence without claiming completed external certifications.

operations.title: Operations

objects.title: Object Management

objects.purpose: Anchor every report, patrol and instruction to a shared site model so context is never re-entered.

personnel.title: Personnel
personnel.overview: Personnel and workforce management are in active development. Scheduling and assignment authority are established foundations.
personnel.purpose: Keep assignments tied to operational objects. Qualification authority is in discovery, not an available qualification system.

trust.summary: ISB trust architecture layers from identity through roles and permissions, tenant boundaries, data access, operational actions, audit trail, to storage and infrastructure. Designed around least-privilege access, tenant-aware boundaries and traceable operational actions. Production controls remain subject to deployment validation. No certifications claimed.
trust.intro: ISB is being designed around identity, role-based access, tenant boundaries, traceability and controlled operational data flows. Production controls remain subject to deployment and infrastructure validation.

identity.label: Identity
identity.purpose: Identity and organization context form the first access boundary.

roles.label: Roles & Permissions
roles.purpose: Designed around least-privilege access — what a user may view, create, approve or manage.
roles.controls: Role scopes · supervisor vs officer vs customer context · function-specific access

tenant.label: Tenant Boundaries
tenant.purpose: Tenant-aware data boundaries separate organizations, customers and objects.
tenant.controls: Company separation · customer separation · object separation · authorized context only

data.label: Data Access
data.purpose: Architecture supports context-aware data access and row-level data controls.
data.controls: Role + tenant + object context · API boundaries · secure storage foundations

actions.label: Operational Actions
actions.purpose: Sensitive actions occur only after identity, permission and context checks.
actions.controls: Create/approve report · update instruction · assign officer · close escalation · change context

audit.label: Audit Trail

audit.controls: Action logging · change history · approval association · record history

storage.label: Storage & Infrastructure
storage.purpose: Production infrastructure controls remain subject to deployment validation.
storage.controls: Controlled storage · environment separation · access controls · backup direction · monitoring direction
